_meta.title: Infrastructure — Neural Substrate Overlay
_meta.source_document: LIMEN Helix — Comprehensive Neurology & Nervous System Reference (Jul 2026). THIS DOCUMENT ONLY. Domain-generic sections copied verbatim from finance-neuro-substrate.json (which copied them verbatim from energy-neuro-substrate.json).
_meta.additive_contract: Purely additive overlay. Does NOT modify assets/data/domains/infrastructure.json or any existing infrastructure file. References existing Infrastructure node IDs and issue IDs by value only. Mirrors the Energy/Finance neuro-substrate overlay shape for the Infrastructure domain.
_meta.advisory_only: This overlay is ADVISORY. It classifies existing authored circuits against the source document's Part XIV failure taxonomy and runs the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test. It writes nothing back and changes no live behavior on load.
grounded_sections: fractal_critical_mechanisms, inhibitory_motifs_catalog, oscillatory_bands, failure_modes, parameter_table, references — DOMAIN-GENERIC, copied verbatim from finance-neuro-substrate.json / energy-neuro-substrate.json (source-document-grounded).
issue_failure_class_map — 4 of 5 Infrastructure issues (GRID_FAILURE, BRIDGE_COLLAPSE, WATER_CRISIS, TELECOM_OUTAGE) grounded in each issue's OWN canonical circuit detail and/or summary text.
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic — run against infrastructure.json real _authored circuits; verdict PASS 5/5.
heterogeneity_flagged: TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN — UNMAPPED. Its named mechanism (canonical M1[Hypo] 'primary motor cortex — motor output — weakness, paresis') is a SIMPLE HYPOFUNCTION / low-drive state, and its summary causes ('labor strikes, funding crises, ridership collapse') are largely socio-economic / adversarial. None of the 9 Part XIV classes (all E/I-DYSREGULATION archetypes: excessive excitation, lost inhibition, stuck gating, failed clearance, bad synchrony, propagation) expresses simple effector weakness with no runaway and no gating lesion. Corroborated by the source data: infrastructure.json resolved.motif for TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN is null (the authoring pass itself could not assign a motif), whereas the other four issues resolved to M4/M6/M3. Marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit. THIS IS THE KEY FINDING: Infrastructure contains a failure archetype (effector paresis + non-dynamical strike/funding causes) that the E/I-dynamics neuro-substrate taxonomy cannot represent — the Infrastructure analog of Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL.

GRID_FAILURE and TELECOM_OUTAGE — TWIN GATING. Both carry the identical canonical single-node cue THAL[Hypo] 'gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation' and are classed identically as GATING_FAILURE (mirrors Finance's twin BANKING_CRISIS / CREDIT_FREEZE both on the GP output-gate-lock cue). Both ALSO carry a strong DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS cascade in their summaries (grid: 'disrupting all electricity-dependent systems'; telecom: 'isolating populations and disabling digital-dependent services including banking, navigation, and emergency communications'). Classed on the primary node cue (gating), with the cascade recorded as secondary.

BRIDGE_COLLAPSE — classed NEURODEGENERATION on its summary/authored maintenance cue ('systemic neglect in infrastructure maintenance and inspection'; authored dACC 'failed in detecting progressive structural deterioration' = maintenance failure compounding over time). Two divergences recorded: (1) the canonical NODE cue dACC[Hypo] 'conflict/error monitor — noise-chase' points instead at a detection/monitoring failure flavor; (2) the authored primary node UNC[Hypo] 'Critical crossing link severed, fragmenting transportation network and isolating connected communities' carries a DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS consequence. Neither divergence is resolved by guessing.

WATER_CRISIS — classed OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY on the explicit canonical cue HYPO[Hypo] 'homeostatic set-point — delayed=oscillation'. HONESTY NOTE: OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY is canonically about neural communication-through-coherence (coupling band), whereas here the oscillation is generated by a DELAYED HOMEOSTATIC FEEDBACK loop (a control-theory oscillation). The map is by PHENOTYPE (pathological oscillation from a mistuned loop), not by generator; recorded rather than hidden.
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Infrastructure-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test. Infrastructure carries 32 activations (more than Energy or Finance); only 15 of them appear in an authored issue circuit, so this overlay operates on the 5 authored issues and does not fabricate circuits for the 17 non-authored activations (see infrastructure-condition-trigger-aliases.json for the orphan tally).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Infrastructure issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or summary, quoted in infra_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where the issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 classes, it is marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.

GRID_FAILURE.infra_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; authored THAL: "Electrical grid relay and distribution functions collapsed, severing power delivery to dependent systems"; summary: "Cascading electrical grid failure resulting in widespread blackouts, disrupting all electricity-dependent systems"
GRID_FAILURE.reasoning: The named mechanism is a routing/relay GATE stuck closed. A gate stuck closed producing downstream starvation (power delivery severed to dependent systems) is the GATING_FAILURE archetype (gate stuck closed -> starvation), matching the canonical THAL M4 'gating relay / routing' resolved motif (resolved.motif = M4 in infrastructure.json).
GRID_FAILURE.note: Summary also carries a DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS cascade ('disrupting all electricity-dependent systems including hospitals, water treatment, communications'); classed on the primary node cue (gate stuck-closed), which is the dominant mechanism named. See heterogeneity_flagged (twin-GATING with TELECOM_OUTAGE).

BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.subtype: maintenance failure compounding over time -> structural collapse
BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.infra_text: summary: "Catastrophic structural failure of critical bridge or tunnel infrastructure... revealing systemic neglect in infrastructure maintenance and inspection"; authored dACC[Hypo]: "Building code inspection and monitoring systems revealed to have failed in detecting progressive structural deterioration"
BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.reasoning: 'Progressive structural deterioration' + 'systemic neglect in infrastructure maintenance and inspection' -> collapse is definitionally the NEURODEGENERATION class ('maintenance failure compounding over time'). The deferred-maintenance decay spiral is the domain analog of aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse.
BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.note: TWO divergences flagged, neither resolved by guessing: (1) canonical NODE cue dACC[Hypo] 'conflict/error monitor — noise-chase' points at a detection/monitoring-failure flavor (resolved.motif = M6); (2) authored primary node UNC[Hypo] 'Critical crossing link severed, fragmenting transportation network and isolating connected communities' carries a DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS consequence (link loss propagates across the transport graph). Primary class chosen on the maintenance-compounding cause; consequence and node-cue recorded.

WATER_CRISIS.subtype: delayed-feedback loop -> pathological oscillation (mapped by phenotype)
WATER_CRISIS.infra_text: canonical circuit HYPO[Hypo]: "homeostatic set-point — delayed=oscillation"; authored HYPO: "Water treatment and distribution homeostasis broken, delivering contaminated or insufficient water to populations"; summary: "Failure of water treatment or distribution infrastructure leading to contamination, supply shortages"
WATER_CRISIS.reasoning: The canonical cue explicitly names 'oscillation' ('homeostatic set-point — delayed=oscillation'): a delayed negative-feedback control loop that swings between contamination and shortage. OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY is the only Part XIV class whose core phenotype is pathological oscillation, so the map is grounded on the issue's own 'oscillation' text.
WATER_CRISIS.note: HONESTY NOTE: OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY is canonically about NEURAL communication-through-coherence (coupling band; hyper/under-synchrony), whereas the water-crisis oscillation is generated by DELAYED HOMEOSTATIC FEEDBACK (a control-theory oscillation), which is closer to the CORTICAL_SPREADING_DEPRESSION homeostasis invariant. Mapped by PHENOTYPE (pathological oscillation from a mistuned loop), not by generator. resolved.motif = M3 (HIPP/HYPO homeostatic feedback), corroborating the homeostatic reading.

TELECOM_OUTAGE.infra_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hypo]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-closed=starvation"; authored LANG[Hypo]: "Telecommunications transmission capacity lost, severing voice and data communication links across affected area"; summary: "Major telecommunications infrastructure failure... isolating populations and disabling digital-dependent services including banking, navigation, and emergency communications"
TELECOM_OUTAGE.reasoning: Identical canonical cue to GRID_FAILURE: THAL routing/relay gate 'stuck-closed=starvation' (resolved.motif = M4). Transmission capacity lost / links severed = the relay gate stuck closed starving downstream services = GATING_FAILURE. Classed identically to GRID_FAILURE on the identical cue (twin-GATING, mirrors Finance BANKING_CRISIS / CREDIT_FREEZE).
TELECOM_OUTAGE.note: The summary carries a STRONG DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS cascade ('isolating populations and disabling digital-dependent services including banking, navigation, and emergency communications') and the authored chain (LANG severed -> FPN offline -> CeA 911 disrupted -> dlPFC/STRI coordination lost) is a textbook dependent-system propagation. Classed on the primary node cue (gating); the diaschisis cascade is the dominant secondary and is recorded, not resolved by guessing.

TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN.reason: Issue text names a mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN.infra_text: canonical circuit M1[Hypo]: "primary motor cortex — motor output — weakness, paresis"; authored STRI[Hypo]: "Routine transit service halted as trains and buses pulled from service due to mechanical failure or labor action"; summary: "Systemic failure of public transit systems through mechanical breakdowns, labor strikes, funding crises, or ridership collapse, stranding commuters"
TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN.reasoning: The dominant named mechanism is M1 'motor output — weakness, paresis' = a SIMPLE HYPOFUNCTION / low-drive state (an intact effector producing too little output). The 9 Part XIV classes are all DYSREGULATION archetypes (excessive excitation, lost inhibition, stuck gating, failed clearance, bad synchrony, cross-graph propagation); none names simple effector weakness with no runaway and no gating lesion (GATING_FAILURE's 'gate stuck closed' requires a GATE, not a weak effector). The summary compounds this with substantially NON-DYNAMICAL causes — 'labor strikes' (adversarial work stoppage) and 'funding crises' (economic) — outside the E/I-dynamics taxonomy. Forcing it into any of the 9 would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN.note: This is the KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING for Infrastructure (analog of Finance's FRAUD_SCANDAL). CORROBORATION FROM THE SOURCE DATA: infrastructure.json resolved.motif for TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN is null (source: override) — the authoring pass itself assigned no motif — whereas the other four issues resolved to M4/M6/M3. A secondary NEURODEGENERATION signal exists in authored M1 ('unable to keep pace with repair backlog on aging transit infrastructure'), but it is a subordinate node detail, not the primary/canonical cue, so it does not lift the issue out of UNMAPPED.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against infrastructure.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list). Verified by requiring energy-neuro-substrate.js and calling validateIncompleteCircuit(issue) on each infrastructure issue.
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS (5/5). Every authored circuit includes at least one regulatory/feedback node; none is a bare excitatory driver without its brake. Same headline result as Energy (6/6) and Finance (6/6). NOTE: THREE issues (GRID_FAILURE, TELECOM_OUTAGE, TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN) have CANONICAL single-node circuits (THAL, THAL, M1 respectively) that are bare non-regulatory nodes and WOULD fail the test in isolation; the _authored multi-node circuits supply the regulatory partner. Only BRIDGE_COLLAPSE (canonical dACC) and WATER_CRISIS (canonical HYPO) have canonical single nodes that are themselves regulatory.

GRID_FAILURE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hypo] alone (M4 gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies HYPO (homeostatic feedback).

BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is dACC[Hypo] (conflict monitor, IS in REGULATORY_NODES) -> canonical-only would also pass; _authored keeps dACC plus adds the effector/router arms.

WATER_CRISIS.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is HYPO[Hypo] (homeostatic set-point, IS in REGULATORY_NODES) -> canonical-only would also pass; _authored adds dACC oversight.

TELECOM_OUTAGE.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hypo] alone (M4 gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES, and THAL is not even in the _authored list) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies dlPFC (cognitive control).

TRANSIT_BREAKDOWN.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is M1[Hypo] alone (motor output, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies CBLM (forward-model error-correct) and dlPFC. Circuit is structurally COMPLETE under the incomplete-circuit test, yet the issue is UNMAPPED in the failure-class map: a circuit can be complete and still express a failure archetype (effector paresis + strike/funding causes) outside the 9-class taxonomy. The two diagnostics are independent (same pattern as Finance FRAUD_SCANDAL).

parameter_table._note: Part XV, verbatim. Quantitative substrate for scale-rescaling. Confidence + anchor preserved.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Infrastructure mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation (e.g. real-time grid-frequency control vs multi-year capital-maintenance cycles), or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
